hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
PROJECT_DIR="/var/www/pinterest-tool-next"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "❌ Directory not found"; exit 1; }
echo ">>> Pulling latest code" git pull
echo ">>> Rebuilding & restarting Docker container" docker compose up -d --build
echo ">>> Verifying container is healthy" sleep 5 if curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3002/; then echo "✅ App is up and responding on :3002" else echo "❌ App failed health check" docker compose logs --tail 30 exit 1 fi
echo ">>> Purging Cloudflare cache for: ${SUBDOMAIN}" curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID}/purge_cache" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data "{ \"files\": [ \"https://${SUBDOMAIN}/*\" ] }"
echo "✅ Deploy complete"
